name: grounded
_doc: Asserts the live SKILL.md carries the grounded-mode phase that enforces 'Claude assembles, the founder decides': no originated tokens, no originated copy, every open choice a fork, synthesis assembles never originates. The token-source format itself is enforced by check_token_provenance.py.

assertions.section: ## Grounded mode (Claude assembles, the founder decides)
assertions.reason: the grounded-mode phase must state all four no-originate rules
SKILL.md must require a source per token and forbid Claude originating one
